name: Effective Range / Threshold Dimension
details: Every coordinate of a nontrivial threshold trace is active.
proof: A threshold trace on S contains concepts with different labels at every coordinate of S. Hence every coordinate of S belongs to the effective range, so \(\mathrm E(\mathcal H)\ge\mathrm T(\mathcal H)\).
witness_verification: For $n$ singleton concepts, effective range is $n$ while threshold dimension is 1.
